The Together API is [OpenAI-compatible](https://docs.together.ai/docs/inference/openai-compatibility), so most third-party SDKs work by pointing them at `https://api.together.ai/v1` and supplying your [Together API key](https://docs.together.ai/docs/api-keys-authentication). The integrations below ship dedicated Together support, with first-class clients, helpers, or providers.[Agent frameworks](https://docs.together.ai/docs/agent-integrations) (CrewAI, LangGraph, DSPy, PydanticAI, AutoGen, Agno, Composio) have their own dedicated pages. If you’re migrating from the v1 Python SDK, see the [Python SDK v2 migration](https://docs.together.ai/docs/pythonv2-migration-guide) appendix.

## [​](https://docs.together.ai/docs/inference/sdk-integrations\#langchain)  LangChain

[LangChain](https://www.langchain.com/) is a framework for building context-aware, reasoning applications powered by LLMs. The `langchain-together` package provides chat models and embeddings.

Shell

```
uv add langchain-together
```

Python

```
from langchain_together import ChatTogether

chat = ChatTogether(
    model="moonshotai/Kimi-K3",
    extra_body={"reasoning": {"enabled": False}},
)

for chunk in chat.stream("Tell me fun things to do in NYC"):
    print(chunk.content, end="", flush=True)
```

For more LangChain integration details, see the [LangChain provider docs](https://python.langchain.com/docs/integrations/providers/together/).

## [​](https://docs.together.ai/docs/inference/sdk-integrations\#llamaindex)  LlamaIndex

[LlamaIndex](https://www.llamaindex.ai/) is a data framework for connecting custom data sources to LLMs. Together AI works with LlamaIndex through the `OpenAILike` LLM and dedicated embedding classes.

Shell

```
uv add llama-index llama-index-llms-openai-like
```

Python

```
import os
from llama_index.llms.openai_like import OpenAILike

llm = OpenAILike(
    model="moonshotai/Kimi-K3",
    api_base="https://api.together.ai/v1",
    api_key=os.environ["TOGETHER_API_KEY"],
    is_chat_model=True,
    is_function_calling_model=True,
    temperature=0.1,
)

response = llm.complete("Explain large language models in 500 words.")
print(response)
```

For more LlamaIndex integration details, see the [LlamaIndex Together LLM docs](https://docs.llamaindex.ai/en/stable/examples/llm/together/).

## [​](https://docs.together.ai/docs/inference/sdk-integrations\#litellm)  LiteLLM

[LiteLLM](https://docs.litellm.ai/) is an open-source gateway with a single OpenAI-format interface for over 100 LLM providers, available as a Python SDK and a proxy server. LiteLLM 1.100.0 and later ships official Together AI support, with a model registry that syncs against the serverless catalog daily.

Shell

```
uv add "litellm>=1.100.0"
export TOGETHERAI_API_KEY=<your_key>
```

Python

```
import litellm

response = litellm.completion(
    model="together_ai/zai-org/GLM-5.3",
    messages=[\
        {\
            "role": "user",\
            "content": "What are some fun things to do in New York?",\
        }\
    ],
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

Streaming (`stream=True`), function calling (`tools`), JSON mode (`response_format`), and `reasoning_effort` all pass through in the OpenAI format. Reasoning models return their reasoning in a separate `reasoning_content` field, so `content` holds only the final answer.You can also [run Claude Code on Together models](https://docs.together.ai/docs/using-together-with-litellm) through the LiteLLM proxy.

## [​](https://docs.together.ai/docs/inference/sdk-integrations\#helicone)  Helicone

[Helicone](https://www.helicone.ai/) is an open-source LLM observability platform. Route Together requests through Helicone’s gateway by overriding `base_url` and adding the auth header.

Python

TypeScript

cURL

```
import os
from together import Together

client = Together(
    api_key=os.environ["TOGETHER_API_KEY"],
    base_url="https://together.hconeai.com",
    default_headers={
        "Helicone-Auth": f"Bearer {os.environ['HELICONE_API_KEY']}",
    },
)

stream = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B",
    messages=[\
        {\
            "role": "user",\
            "content": "What are some fun things to do in New York?",\
        }\
    ],
    stream=True,
)

for chunk in stream:
    if chunk.choices:
        print(chunk.choices[0].delta.content or "", end="", flush=True)
```

```
import Together from "together-ai";

const client = new Together({
  apiKey: process.env.TOGETHER_API_KEY,
  baseURL: "https://together.hconeai.com",
  defaultHeaders: {
    "Helicone-Auth": `Bearer ${process.env.HELICONE_API_KEY}`,
  },
});

const stream = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: "Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B",
  messages: [\
    { role: "user", content: "What are some fun things to do in New York?" },\
  ],
  stream: true,
});

for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.choices[0]?.delta?.content ?? "");
}
```

## [​](https://docs.together.ai/docs/inference/sdk-integrations\#agent-frameworks)  Agent frameworks

Each framework below has a dedicated guide with installation, model selection, and runnable examples:

- [CrewAI](https://docs.together.ai/docs/crewai): Open-source orchestration for multi-agent workflows.
- [LangGraph](https://docs.together.ai/docs/langgraph): Stateful, multi-actor applications built on LangChain.
- [DSPy](https://docs.together.ai/docs/dspy): Modular AI systems written in code instead of prompt strings.
- [PydanticAI](https://docs.together.ai/docs/pydanticai): Typed agent framework from the Pydantic team.
- [AutoGen (AG2)](https://docs.together.ai/docs/autogen): Conversational multi-agent systems.
- [Agno](https://docs.together.ai/docs/agno): Open-source library for multimodal agents.
- [Composio](https://docs.together.ai/docs/composio): Tool-use platform for connecting agents to external services.
